title: National Waterway 11 _Arunawati Aran River System:
text:
11. National Waterway 11 _Arunawati Aran River System:_

Bridge on State Highway No. 211 at Lat 20[o]13‟33”N, Lon
77[o]33‟23”E to confluence of Arunawati and Aran rivers near
Ratanapur village at Lat 19[o]59‟31”N, Lon 78[o]09‟38”E
to confluence of Aran and Penganga rivers near Chimata village
at Lat 19[o]54‟08”N, Lon 78[o]12‟36”E.
